simulators_subtitle: Choose a simulator to explore its controls and discover what you can observe in each experiment.

showcase.signin_note: Sign in for free to run the simulators.

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Read the same key, adjust TTL, and see when the response comes from memory or the database.
cache.alt: Cache simulator preview showing the client, cache, and database flow, stored entries, and a read served from memory.

load-balancer.title: Load Balancing
load-balancer.description: Compare Round Robin, Least Connections, and random distribution while changing server count and traffic.
load-balancer.controls: Strategy, server count, and incoming traffic
load-balancer.alt: Load balancing simulator showing strategy selection, traffic settings, and the load on each server.

circuit-breaker.title: Circuit Breaker
circuit-breaker.description: Introduce errors and watch the circuit stop calls, test recovery, and start serving requests again.
circuit-breaker.controls: Failures, error threshold, and recovery timeout
circuit-breaker.observe: Closed, open, and half-open circuit states
circuit-breaker.alt: Circuit Breaker simulator showing circuit state, failure controls, and request history.

kafka.title: Kafka
kafka.description: Produce messages, adjust consumers, and see how partitions distribute work and lag builds up.
kafka.controls: Partitions, consumers, production and consumption rates
kafka.alt: Kafka simulator showing a producer, partitions, a consumer group, and produced, consumed, and pending message metrics.

consistent-hashing.title: Consistent Hashing
consistent-hashing.description: Add or remove nodes and watch which keys move around the distribution ring.
consistent-hashing.controls: Number of nodes and virtual nodes
consistent-hashing.observe: Key distribution and movement between nodes
consistent-hashing.alt: Consistent hashing ring preview with virtual nodes and highlighted keys that moved to a new node.

rag-pipeline.title: RAG Pipeline
rag-pipeline.description: Adjust retrieval and context in a RAG pipeline to compare the effects on simulated quality, latency, and cost.
rag-pipeline.observe: Simulated quality, recall, latency, and cost
rag-pipeline.alt: RAG pipeline simulator showing embedding, search, reranking, context assembly, and generation stages alongside controls and metrics.

teacher_about_me_text1: Hi! My name is Flávio, and I currently work as an Engineering Manager in Distributed Systems.
teacher_about_me_text2: In this material my intention is to put all these 16+ years of experience into practice, so that you leave here with the mindset that besides having technical repertoire, you need to get hands-on, experiment and validate your solutions.
teacher_about_me_text3: In my day-to-day I work on high performance, scalability and availability projects where we reach more than 1.5 billion requests per year.

topology_title: Follow a request through the stack
topology_subtitle: Client to load balancer to nodes to cache and database — every hop here is something you can open, run, and break inside a simulator.
topology_card1_text: Spread traffic across healthy nodes and watch routing adapt as instances come and go.
topology_card2_text: Cut latency and shield your database by serving hot reads straight from memory.
topology_card3_text: Circuit breakers, timeouts and retries stop a single failure from cascading.
topology_card4_text: Replicate state across regions and reason about real consistency trade-offs.
